title: What founders ask before they book a call

items.a: You do. Full ownership of the code and intellectual property transfers on final payment. We keep only the right to say we built it.
A deposit books your start date. After that, you pay per milestone once it ships and you sign it off. The fixed price is in the contract, so every invoice matches finished work.
The deadline is in the contract, and you pay per finished milestone. If we're late, you haven't paid for that milestone yet.
Anything outside the agreed scope. We price it in writing before we build it, so the deadline you signed off stays the same.
Your code is in your own accounts, with documentation and a set period of free fixes. To keep shipping, the Build Partner Retainer costs from €4k a month and you can cancel anytime.

The studio is two founders working with AI agents. The agents design, write, test and ship the software. The founders own the architecture, the code review and the security gates, and decide what is ready to ship.

items.q: Where can I see your work?
items.a: On the Work page. We show our own products first. Bloop, an AI concierge app that finds events and things to do in your city, is in build and piloting in Bologna. Washiiba, a full marketplace platform with a customer app, a supplier portal and an admin back office, is built end to end. Kerf is a case study on public LiDAR data. It is not yet validated in the field and has no paying customer, and it has its own site, projectkerf.com. Recovery Room, a booking tool, is a pilot live at a gym in Cagliari.

items.q: What happens after I book a call?
items.a: First, a 45-minute diagnostic call. It costs {price}, and the fee comes off the project price if you go ahead. Within 2 business days you get a written fixed-price proposal. If it fits, you pay the deposit, we agree a start date, and the build begins.
